summary: Genvor Inc filed an 8-K on May 18, 2026, announcing the appointment of Donald Kalkofen as Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Mr. Kalkofen, a seasoned CFO with experience in biotech and finance, will serve under an Acting CFO Services Agreement with Wave Financial Consulting LLC. Compensation includes $6,250/month cash, $7,750/month deferred cash, and 10-year stock options to purchase 575,000 shares. No departure of a previous CFO was noted. This is a routine executive appointment, not an abrupt or forced change. The filing cites Items 5.02, 8.01, and 9.01. There are no deal terms, as this is not a transaction. Watch for future SEC filings regarding the prior CFO's status if any.
